newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia names new competition agency member.
newsitem.headline: Australia names new competition agency member.

text.p: The Australian government on Thursday appointed senior Treasury official Rod Shogren as a new member of the country's competition watchdog, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC).

Treasurer Peter Costello said the appointment of an additional commissioner was the result of an increasing workload for the agency, including overseeing competition policy in the telecommunications industry after its deregulation from July 1.
The commission is charged with preventing anti-competitive behaviour, enforcing fair trading standards and promoting competitive pricing.

Shogren has been head of Treasury's fiscal policy division for the past four years. He has also worked for the Department of Primary Industries and Energy, the Finance Department and the Industry Commission.
